description: Fetch the bulletin board for a neighborhood. Prerequisite: the bot must be connected to the city server (any session state). Effect: returns the neighborhood's full bulletin list (subject, body, sender, timestamp, type: mayor/system/community, flags). Cost: none — read-only. Wire: BulletinRequest{Type=GET_MESSAGES, TargetNHood} on the city Aries socket; resolves on the next BulletinResponse{Type=MESSAGES, Messages[]}. Default neighborhood_id=1 (Alphaville default shard nhood).
common_mistakes: neighborhood_id not found → server returns FAIL_NHOOD_NOT_FOUND, surfaced as ok:false.
10s timeout if server is wedged; retry policy is caller-side.
perception_hints: Neighborhood id (defaults to 1 on workshop): perception.lot.lot_id is a lot id, not a nhood id — most ops default nhood_id to 1
Your own persist_id (to avoid self-vote/self-nominate): perception.avatar.persist_id
Your lot membership (residency gate): perception.lot.owner_is_me or check is_roommate via query-lot
refuse_conditions: server returns non-MESSAGES response type → ok:false with type name
